toxic_note.en: Very poisonous: contains colchicine. Eating any part can be fatal.
toxic_note.ro: Foarte otrăvitoare: conține colchicină. Consumul oricărei părți poate fi mortal.

note.en: The leaves can be mistaken for each other. Confusing them has caused serious poisonings.
note.ro: Frunzele pot fi confundate. Confuzia a provocat intoxicații grave.
